data_contract.volume_field_status: DATA_GAP (volume=volume_real=last identically 0) -> any flow feature carries _PROXY suffix

cost_model.slippage_assumption: SIGNED; only unfavorable leg counts; measured entry/exit slippage from CALIBRATION pilot (19 RT) as distribution, not a scalar

statistics.IS_OOS_split: time-ordered by trading day, first 70% IS / last 30% OOS (no shuffle)
statistics.significance: block bootstrap CI (n=2000, block=60s of event time) + permutation test (n=2000, circular event-time shift within segment)
statistics.direction_policy: each information source frozen BOTH ways (continuation and reversal) as independent hypotheses
statistics.ladder_note: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE first (eff<30); COST_INSUFFICIENT when gross<cost anchor (NOT REJECT); no promotion because numbers look good

frozen_thresholds.thresholds_are: A_PRIORI_CONSISTENT_WITH_PRIOR_ROUNDS (|z|>=2 and trailing-quantile conventions reused; NO parameter scan)

execution_model.entry: long enters at ask, short enters at bid (never mid)
execution_model.exit: exit at mid after horizon h
execution_model.censoring: event forward windows crossing a segment break (session gap > 60s or sample end) are HORIZON_CENSORED and EXCLUDED, counted separately

D_event_microstructure.reason: no PIT event calendar overlapping the tick window 2026-08-04..2026-09-22; Jin10 window is 2026-09-21..26 (prior round), zero overlap; do not fabricate

E_crossmarket_leadlag.reason: Yahoo 5m DXY/VIX/^TNX overlaps only 2026-08-25..09-18 (~18 trading days); DXY shock already tested in prior round R2/F1-F2; new lead-lag at 5m has thin eff_n; reported as LIMITED/DEFERRED not as alpha

hypotheses.mechanism: tick-rule quote imbalance shock -> short-horizon CONTINUATION
hypotheses.feature: TI_PROXY = (sum sign(dmid) over trailing 100 ticks) / sqrt(100)

hypotheses.mechanism: tick-rule quote imbalance shock -> short-horizon REVERSAL
price shock (|z|>=2 vs trailing 3000-tick std of tick returns) -> CONTINUATION
spread regime WIDE (>= trailing q67) -> mean-reversion of mid
hypotheses.feature: spread_bp vs trailing 3000-tick median; regime WIDE_GE q67

hypotheses.mechanism: quote arrival-rate burst (>= trailing q90 ticks/sec) -> continuation
hypotheses.feature: ticks-per-second over trailing 5s vs trailing q90

hypotheses.mechanism: microprice position extreme (>=0.70) -> entering at ask/bid is EXECUTION-favorable
realized-vol regime persistence -> forward |move| exceeds cost-adjusted threshold (non-directional)
hypotheses.feature: rv_500 vs trailing 3000-tick rv median (regime HIGH_GE q67)
